output.answer_markdown: Sysco says the pandemic may shift its mix of earnings across taxing jurisdictions and has raised the risk of operating losses in some of them [1]. If those losses are prolonged beyond current expectations, Sysco could have to record valuation allowances against certain deferred tax assets [2]. The company says these effects would negatively affect income tax expense, net earnings and the balance sheet [3]. The passages do not say whether these effects would continue after the pandemic subsides.
